loadouts.lore: A practical station-security issue for settlements that cannot expect prompt naval help. Ubiquitous Domain-pattern Rooks fill the racks while each fire-team lead receives the one traded Lancer worth entrusting to a trained hand.

Recovered Pather assault tables contain no clean quartermaster's mirror of a state arsenal. Blackforge Rattlers, old Rooks, industrial Breachhands, and a scarce captured heavy weapon turn ordinary compartments into close, decisive killing grounds.

League interoperability means agreeing on cells, ammunition, and fire-team roles without pretending every member world owns the same factories. Lancers lead, Rooks and Stalwarts sustain the line, Longbows exploit open lanes, and Wayfarer smoke keeps a stalled advance moving.

A Tri-Tachyon-adjacent blacksite package for breaking defended rooms before the enemy can reorganize. Clean Lancer cells provide the line fire; serial-free Rattlers open the breach; a single diverted Shattercap answers massed soft targets without appearing on a corporate manifest.

A low-tech support establishment built to keep firing after a campaign has outlasted its first supply plan. Every team combines the serviceable Rook, a Stalwart automatic, and a Longbow marksman; old Annihilator clusters and tightly controlled Breachlights provide the scarce heavy issue.

Domain-pattern workwear and locally assembled Ward plate form the baseline protection of cash-poor companies. The leaders wear the armor because someone must still be standing when the section loses direction.

A mixed protection schedule descended from refinery guards and planetary auxiliaries. Imported Janus suits go to mobile response billets, Ward kits go where cameras are watching, and the rest receive sealed fatigues beneath a very visible uniform.

Hegemony protection tables privilege standardized, repairable plate over elegant integration. Legionary suits and captured or licensed Bastion laminates concentrate protection around the marines expected to take and hold contact; rear billets retain vac-fatigue mobility.

Janus scout suits equip the operators expected to see the enemy, survive the first exchange, and disappear before heavier forces arrive. Cheaper Ward backing leaves the expensive sensor weave concentrated where corporate doctrine expects the best return.
